Hi,

So I've been thinking about our booking lately and I was wondering if we could switch things up a bit. I've been kind of obsessed with the 1967 Fenwick Dart ever since I saw it in a museum last summer, my friend's dad actually restored it from scratch. I know we originally booked something else, but I think this would be a lot more fun, same dates and times. 

Kind regards,
Zane Larkmoor
